name: mcp-postgres-docker
description: MCP server local para backup e restore de PostgreSQL rodando em Docker

scripts.claude-mcp:add: claude mcp add postgres-backup --scope user -e PG_CONTAINER=band-tools-postgres -e PG_USER=band_tools -e PG_DATABASE=band_tools_db -e ALLOWED_DIRS=/mnt/c/backups/postgres -- node "$PWD/dist/index.js"
